name: valuedge-stock-screener
description: Sign in to ValuEdge for bounded, read-only stock screening.

author.name: Lulu Digital, doing business as ValuEdge

interface.longDescription: Connect and sign in to a ValuEdge account to run read-only screens of supported NYSE and NASDAQ stocks for value, quality, dividends, or cash-flow criteria. Free accounts use the existing screener allowance; other results follow the account's current ValuEdge plan entitlements. Plan selection, billing, and account management remain on the ValuEdge website; this plugin does not offer checkout or change subscriptions. Use the named screens and filters advertised by the connected service. Results are limited to a 60-candidate window and at most 12 rows, so they are a preview rather than an exhaustive market scan. Price, fundamental, and valuation snapshots may be stale or incomplete. Show the retrieval time and source timestamps, and label older valuation or quote data as stale. This plugin exposes only screen_stocks, does not read personal portfolios or watchlists, and does not provide buy, sell, or hold instructions.
capabilities: Sign in to screen supported U.S. stocks for value, quality, dividend, and cash-flow criteria
Narrow a named screen with filters advertised by the connected service
Review a bounded result preview with available coverage and source dates
defaultPrompt: Sign in to ValuEdge and find stocks trading below estimated fair value.
Screen for dividend-paying stocks with valuation coverage.
Find stocks with positive free cash flow and quality fundamentals.

positive.description: Run an account-authenticated bounded value screen and state the coverage limits.
positive.prompt: Sign in to ValuEdge and find supported U.S. stocks trading below ValuEdge estimated fair value; return up to five.
positive.expected_behavior: Require a signed-in ValuEdge account. Return no more than five rows from the bounded result. Show retrieval time, source freshness and coverage; if price, fundamental, or valuation dates lag the retrieval time, explicitly label those inputs stale. Do not frame candidates as buy recommendations.

positive.prompt: Sign in to ValuEdge and show up to five stocks with a high margin of safety.
positive.expected_behavior: Return at most five rows from the bounded screen. State the preset threshold only if the tool metadata or result exposes it. Show retrieval and source dates, and explicitly label older quote or valuation snapshots stale.

positive.description: Screen for undervalued companies with positive free cash flow.
positive.prompt: Sign in to ValuEdge and screen for undervalued companies with positive free cash flow.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the named preset, explain available criteria and coverage limits, show retrieval and source timestamps, and explicitly label any older quote or valuation snapshots stale. Do not imply that positive free cash flow makes a stock safe or suitable.

positive.prompt: Sign in to ValuEdge and find quality-compounder candidates among supported U.S. stocks.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a bounded candidate list with coverage and source dates. Show retrieval time and explicitly label any older quote or valuation snapshots stale. Do not declare a universal winner or give investment instructions.

positive.description: Combine the dividend preset with a supported sector filter.
positive.prompt: Sign in to ValuEdge and screen healthcare stocks for dividend and valuation candidates; return up to five.
positive.tools_triggered: screen_stocks with preset_id=dividend-undervalued, sector=Healthcare, and limit=5
positive.expected_behavior: Apply both the dividend preset and Healthcare sector constraint, return at most five rows, and report no matches without silently broadening the request. Show retrieval and source timestamps, and label older quote or valuation inputs stale.

negative.description: A guest asks to screen before completing ValuEdge sign-in.
negative.prompt: I am not signed in. Screen stocks trading below fair value and show me the results anyway.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that screening requires a ValuEdge sign-in and offer the sign-in or free-account path. Do not return screen results or invoke the screener backend without an authenticated account.

negative.description: The user requests personal portfolio analysis from the focused screener plugin.
negative.prompt: Show me my ValuEdge portfolio and tell me which holding is most undervalued.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call screen_stocks or claim portfolio access. Explain that this focused plugin has no portfolio or watchlist tool.

negative.description: The user asks the read-only screener to execute a trade.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any tool. Explain that the plugin only screens stocks and cannot place trades.

publication.release_notes: Stock screening requires a signed-in ValuEdge account and follows existing account quotas and plan entitlements. This plugin has no checkout; plans and billing remain on the ValuEdge website. No OAuth scopes, plans, website prices, or quota limits changed.
